company.name: Anja Health
company.shortDescription: Anja Health is a personalized doctor-backed cord blood banking company that freezes umbilical cord and placenta stem cells.
company.description:
Anja Health is a healthcare technology and newborn stem cell preservation company focused on making cord blood, cord tissue, and placental tissue banking more accessible, transparent, and affordable for families.

The company provides expectant parents with comprehensive newborn stem cell preservation services, including collection, transportation, laboratory processing, cryopreservation, long-term storage, and future therapeutic release coordination. Through its ConciergeMax™ preservation process, Anja Health supports the storage of multiple sources of newborn stem cells collected at birth.

Anja Health partners with Vitalant Cord Blood Services, a nationally recognized stem cell processing and storage laboratory located in Allendale, New Jersey. The partnership provides families with access to advanced laboratory processing, detailed stem cell quality reporting, secure cryogenic storage, and experienced cellular therapy professionals.

The company's leadership team has more than 18 years of experience in newborn stem cell preservation and has helped tens of thousands of families preserve newborn stem cells. Anja Health serves expectant parents, fertility clinics, obstetric providers, midwives, surrogacy professionals, and healthcare organizations throughout North America.

Founded with the mission of modernizing the stem cell banking experience, Anja Health combines personalized support, flexible payment options, multilingual customer service, educational resources, and industry-leading protections, including a $100,000 Engraftment Guarantee.

As regenerative medicine and cellular therapies continue to advance, Anja Health aims to help families preserve valuable biological resources available only at birth while expanding access to stem cell preservation through technology, education, and strategic healthcare partnerships.
